name: ColorField
summary: Type a colour as a hex code, or one channel as a number, in the field box with a small preview swatch at the start. It is the typed path beside a colour slider, a swatch grid or a colour area, so nothing needs a drag. The value runs left to right and digits stay Western in every language. On web the bordered field box; on ios the gray rounded field of the colour panel, the hex code in it; on android Material's filled field.
useWhen: An exact colour a person knows: a brand hex code
The value box beside a ColorSlider or in the sliders view of a colour picker
One channel typed as a number: red, hue, opacity
avoidWhen: A colour a person picks by eye
A number that is not a colour

value.description: The colour, controlled: hex, rgb() or hsl(), a React Aria Color, or null for empty.

onChange.description: Called with the committed colour as hex (#rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa when see through) and as a Color, or null when emptied. A value commits on blur and on Enter.

channel.description: Edit one channel as a number instead of the hex code. Stamped as data-channel.

colorSpace.description: The colour space of the channel. Default the space of the value.

shape.description: default: radius.control of the active style. pill: fully round.

preview.description: Shows the colour as a small swatch at the start. Default true for hex, false for a channel.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input; stamps data-disabled.

readOnly.description: The value can be read and copied, not changed; stamps data-readonly.

placeholder.description: A hint, such as #RRGGBB. Never the only label.

locale.description: The locale of the default name and the number format. Default the language of the nearest Theme. Digits stay Western.

aria-label.description: The name when no Field label names it. Default Hex (رمز اللون), or the channel's name.

a11y.role: textbox for hex, from React Aria; a channel field is a textbox with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax. Named by the Field label, else aria-label, else Hex or the channel's name.
a11y.focus: One Tab stop, the input. The ring (focus.shadow.ring) shows on the box at once; the glow fades in.

keys.Enter: Commits the typed value and formats it
keys.ArrowUp: One step up: the next hex value, or one unit of the channel
keys.Pointer: A press on the box focuses the input. No drag anywhere.

a11y.announce: Brand colour, edit text, #1E6FD9. A committed change is announced by React Aria. The preview swatch is hidden from readers: the input already holds the value.
notes: WCAG 2.2 2.5.7: this field is the typed path for every colour control that drags.
Digits stay Western: React Aria formats with an -u-nu-latn locale.
The value runs left to right in right to left pages, on the reading side of the box, as NumberField's does.
The preview swatch has its 3:1 edge (ColorSwatch), so a colour close to the field fill still shows.

en.label: Names what the colour is for: Brand colour, Text colour. Sentence case.

ar.label: اسم بصيغة اسمية بدون تشكيل: لون العلامة، لون النص.

react.behavior: React Aria ColorField and Input (react-aria-components) through their render props; inside a Field it reads the label and the state as NumberField does
react.note: Motion: the focus glow fades in from scale.enter and out on blur, as on Input; the ring shows at once. Reduced motion: no growth, as every duration token is 0ms.

angular.note: New wave 2: div[dsColorField] with the same DOM and the same parsing from color.ts.

native.note: Phase R5 draws it: a TextInput with the ASCII keyboard, autoCapitalize characters, and a swatch View at the start.

styles.web: The bordered field box, a 24px preview swatch at the start, the hex code in tabular figures.
styles.ios: The colour panel's value box: a gray rounded field at the platform's control height; the preview may be hidden there when a swatch already shows the colour.
styles.android: Material's filled field at the Android control height.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A placeholder as the only name
mistakes.right: Put the field in a Field with a label, or pass aria-label

mistakes.wrong: Mirroring the hex code in Arabic
mistakes.right: Keep it left to right; the box does this already
